name: g1_reach_heights
_note: W5 unfamiliar-height reach test. Written before any held-out run. The development set drives fixes (general defects only, each with a regression test); the code is then frozen (SHA recorded in results/g1_reach_heights_heldout/meta.json) and the held-out set is run exactly once. A code change after seeing any held-out result turns that run into development evidence.
success_definition: true distance between the hand's reach point (index fingertip) and the handle centre <= 0.03 m, with no collapse (C3 criteria) and no unresolved protective stop

heldout.handle_colour: drawn per seed from the detector palette (red orange yellow green blue purple)
heldout.fixture_size: depth half 0.15-0.30, width half 0.25-0.50, height from max(0.55, h+0.12) up to +0.5 m (dream/sim/reach_scenes.py)

gates._note: Pre-registered for the new system (agent). The baseline is reported on identical scenes against the same numbers for reference.

disjoint: development seeds 100-105 and held-out seeds 5000-5023 share no seed; the scripted baseline runs the same scene specifications

planner._note: Stance sampling of the agent's posture planner (dream.robot.g1_posture.PlannerConfig). Changed during development from the W3 default radii (0.45, 0.6, 0.75) after dev run 1: a 0.45 m stance leaves the arm nearly straight at the contact point (no room for a pre-contact pose, torque stops).
